disclosure: Fictional counsellor profiles for a prototype. Not actual YourDOST therapists.

counsellors.name: Isha Kapoor
counsellors.title: Illustrative workplace counsellor
counsellors.summary: Supports working professionals who want structured conversations about workload and switching off.
counsellors.detail: Fictional profile for the prototype. Booking is not available.
counsellors.professionalScope: Short, goal-focused online sessions for workplace strain. Not a clinical assessment.
counsellors.referralBoundaries: Does not assess clinical risk or treat diagnosed conditions. Suggests seeking appropriate local professional care if needs fall outside this scope.

counsellors.name: Kabir Mehta
counsellors.title: Illustrative skills-focused counsellor

counsellors.detail: Fictional profile for the prototype. Not an actual YourDOST therapist.
counsellors.professionalScope: Skills-focused online conversations about worry loops and work pressure.
counsellors.referralBoundaries: Not a diagnostic or medical service. Crisis and clinical treatment sit outside this fictional scope.

counsellors.name: Arjun Natarajan
counsellors.title: Illustrative student and early-career counsellor

counsellors.detail: Fictional profile for the prototype. Not an actual YourDOST therapist.

counsellors.referralBoundaries: Not a diagnostic service. Academic or clinical needs beyond supportive counselling are outside this fictional scope.

counsellors.name: Meher Qureshi
